title: SBI Overtakes TCS to Become India’s 4th Most Valuable Company

items: **Market Capitalisation Milestone:** State Bank of India (SBI) surpassed Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) in total market capitalization, reaching **₹10.9 Lakh Crore**.
**PSU Leadership:** SBI solidified its rank as India’s **4th most valuable listed company** and the single most valuable Public Sector Undertaking in the country.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → SBI reached ₹10.9 Lakh Crore m-cap, becoming India’s 4th most valued listed company.
